description: This file defines custom guardrail classes for a language model API, including load balancing testing guardrails and a custom guardrail that masks certain words and rejects responses containing specific keywords.

classes.name: GuardrailForLBTestingA
classes.description: A guardrail class for load balancing testing that increments a counter and logs each call.

classes.name: GuardrailForLBTestingB
classes.description: A guardrail class for load balancing testing that increments a counter and logs each call.

classes.name: myCustomGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class that masks the word 'litellm' in messages, rejects calls containing 'litellm', and raises an error if 'coffee' is in the response.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Method called before the API call to potentially modify input or reject the call.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Method called in parallel to the API call to reject calls based on input content.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Method called after a successful API call to inspect or reject the response.
